Spending <strong>30% or less</strong> of income on housing is treated as not cost burdened; spending <strong>more than 30%</strong> is cost burdened, and <strong>more than 50%</strong> is severely cost burdened. <a href="https://www.huduser.gov/portal/datasets/cp/CHAS/bg_chas.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">HUD CHAS definitions</a>\n          <div class="benchmark-source-quote"><strong>HUD: “A household is said to be cost-burdened when it pays more than 30% of its income toward housing expenses and may have difficulty affording necessities such as food, clothing, transportation, and medical care.”</strong></div>\n
